verzen.tekst: Don’t contend with a mighty man,
verzen.html: Don’t contend with a mighty man,

verzen.tekst: Don’t strive with a rich man, lest perhaps he overpower you;
verzen.html: Don’t strive with a rich man, lest perhaps he overpower you;

verzen.tekst: Don’t argue with a loudmouthed man.
verzen.html: Don’t argue with a loudmouthed man.

verzen.tekst: Don’t make fun of a rude man,
verzen.html: Don’t make fun of a rude man,

verzen.tekst: Don’t reproach a man when he turns from sin.
verzen.html: Don’t reproach a man when he turns from sin.

verzen.tekst: Don’t dishonour a man in his old age,
verzen.html: Don’t dishonour a man in his old age,

verzen.tekst: Don’t neglect the discourse of the wise.
verzen.html: Don’t neglect the discourse of the wise.

verzen.tekst: Don’t miss the discourse of the aged,
verzen.html: Don’t miss the discourse of the aged,

verzen.tekst: Don’t kindle the coals of a sinner,
verzen.html: Don’t kindle the coals of a sinner,

verzen.tekst: Don’t rise up from the presence of an insolent man,
verzen.html: Don’t rise up from the presence of an insolent man,

verzen.tekst: Don’t lend to a man who is stronger than you;
verzen.html: Don’t lend to a man who is stronger than you;

verzen.tekst: Don’t be surety beyond your means.
verzen.html: Don’t be surety beyond your means.

verzen.tekst: Don’t go to law with a judge;
verzen.html: Don’t go to law with a judge;

verzen.tekst: Don’t travel with a reckless man,
verzen.html: Don’t travel with a reckless man,

verzen.tekst: Don’t fight with a wrathful man.
verzen.html: Don’t fight with a wrathful man.

verzen.tekst: Do no secret thing before a stranger,
verzen.html: Do no secret thing before a stranger,

verzen.tekst: Don’t open your heart to every man.
verzen.html: Don’t open your heart to every man.
